repeat.label: Repeat / aggregated requests (carry-forward, aggregation threshold)
repeat.notes: No repeat-request carry-forward or cross-request aggregation rule. The eight-cumulative-hour allowance is per request as read by the AG Outline ('responsive to a particular records request'); nothing authorizes aggregating multiple requests from one requester to reach the threshold. fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: A custodian may charge a fee for providing copies, but the fee shall not exceed the actual added cost of making the copies available.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: When a county custodian provides a copy by transmitting it modem-to-modem, a reasonable fee may be charged for the specialized service, which may include a reasonable amortization of added computer equipment/software cost.

fee.free_allowance.summary: For a Nebraska resident's request, the actual added cost used to calculate a fee shall not include any charge for existing salary/pay obligations for the first eight cumulative hours of searching, identifying, physically redacting, or copying.

denial.denial_form_and_log.summary: Each public body must maintain a file of all letters denying requests, and that file must be made accessible to the public upon request.
